fee_notes: Royalty is 8% of gross sales per Royalty Period, with a minimum of $4,000 per Royalty Period (not monthly — payable by the 15th of each month for periods completed in the prior calendar month). Minimum Royalty is CPI-adjustable annually and may be prorated or waived under certain conditions (force majeure, approved closures). No marketing/ad fund fee disclosed in this excerpt. Additional fees include: Initial Training (no fee currently, but up to $1,000 per attendee beyond 8); uniforms $50–$100 per attendee; Opening Operational Assistance $500/day; Remedial Training $500/day; Online Training $250–$500; Quarterly food safety inspection $177.24 (subject to 4% annual increase); Refused Entry Fee $177.24. No technology fee disclosed.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty: Each Royalty Period you pay us 8% or as otherwise established, unless it is less than the minimum Royalty amount, which is currently $4,000. If the percentage royalty amount is less, then you must pay the minimum Royalty amount for that Restaurant for that Royalty Period, unless otherwise negotiated between you and us. The 15th day of each month for all Royalty Periods completed in the preceding calendar month.

Initial Training Fees: There is no fee for initial training and we do not limit the number of persons who can attend as of the date of this Disclosure Document; but under the License Agreement we can charge up to $1,000 for each attendee beyond 8, per Restaurant. Before training or as incurred. You must pay us $50-$100 for uniforms for each associate who attends.

Opening Operational Assistance: $500 per whole or partial 8-hour day. Before training or as incurred.

Remedial Training Fees & Fees for On Site Consultations Requested by You: $500 per whole or partial 8-hour day. Before training or as incurred.

Online Training/Continuous Education: Range between $250.00 - $500.00. Before training or as incurred.

Inspections/Quality Control Programs: The current charge is $177.24 per quarterly food safety inspection, subject to 4% annual increase. Refused Entry Fee $177.24 will be charged if you refuse the above inspection. As incurred.
